Seer.actual_player_behavior: Nam stated, 'I am the Seer' at the start of the Round 1 Day Debate.
Seer.verdict_notes: Nam revealed his role immediately in Round 1 as directed.

Seer.actual_player_behavior: Nam revealed that he investigated Nhan and that Nhan is not a wolf during the Round 1 debate.
Seer.verdict_notes: Nam shared the results of his investigation immediately after the investigation was complete.

Guard.directive_rationale: Prioritize the Seer exclusively until they are eliminated or the game is won
Guard.actual_player_behavior: Jin (Guard) chose to protect Nhan instead of Nam (Seer).
Guard.verdict_notes: The Seer was alive, but Jin protected Nhan instead of the Seer.

Witch.directive_rationale: Once the Seer identifies a wolf, use the Poison immediately
Witch.verdict_notes: The Seer never confirmed a player as a wolf through investigation; he only cleared villagers.

Villager.directive_rationale: maintain the habit of aggressively questioning 'silent' players
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Riley (Wolf) and Nam (Seer) challenged Cong's silence; however, the Villagers Nhan and Cong did not initiate challenges against silent players.
Villager.verdict_notes: While other roles challenged silence, the players in the Villager role (Nhan, Cong) did not proactively challenge silent players.

Villager.directive_rationale: continue to penalize players who hesitate during role calls
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan (Villager) voted to exile Cong, citing Cong's silence and hesitation during the role call as a reason.
Villager.verdict_notes: Nhan penalized Cong for hesitating during the role call by voting for his exile.

Villager.directive_rationale: continue to penalize players who... attempt to frame Seer-cleared players
Villager.verdict_notes: No player attempted to frame a player that the Seer had explicitly cleared.
